name: Firefly Sunset Resort
brand_truth: Five villas on the Sea of Abaco named for things that glow and fly, rebuilt after Dorian, where the day is measured by the sunset from your deck.
buyer: US families, couples and boaters staying a week in Hope Town; honeymooners; groups booking the whole resort; plus Elbow Cay diners for the Bar & Grill.

design.signature: Live tonight's-sunset clock for Hope Town (solar calculation); villa rate calculator on published season/weekly rates with 3-night minimum and 10% VAT; menu explorer with 'from the sea' filter; CSS firefly glow in the dusk section

current_site_findings: Every page title shows the literal text '<title>' in Google and browser tabs
Homepage slider shows 'Slide title' and 'Button' placeholders over Pexels stock photos
No phone number anywhere on the site
Villa rates and the email-to-book rule buried at the bottom of the villas page
Mint To Be described two different ways (honeymoon suite vs 2B/2B villa)
pitch_line: Google shows your resort as '<title> Firefly Sunset Resort' and your homepage slider still says 'Slide title'; this concept fixes that and lets guests price a villa with VAT and request it in one tap.
assumptions: Phone +1 (242) 366-0145 from their Tablein reservations page (site shows no phone)
Address 'Centre Line Rd, Elbow Cay' from Tablein
Plunge-pool photo (homepage villas tile) shown on Mint To Be
Gallery photos used with generic alt; individual villas have no photo assigned because their site does not label which is which
Weekly rate applied per full 7 nights, remaining nights at daily rate
Seasonal closure: Instagram bio mentions 'closing August 24 & reopening'; confirm current status
notes: Photos hotlinked from their Duda CDN (own photographer, Firefly+Sunset+Resort-NNN); Pexels stock on their homepage excluded. Sunset time computed client-side for Hope Town (26.54N, 76.96W), shown in America/Nassau time. Ask owner for labelled photos of each villa. Guest testimonials on their site not reused. Scorecard: hero 4, type 4, layout 4, context 4, motion 4, depth 4, detailing 4, mobile 4, refs 4, pride 4, consistency 4.
